text: Hino woodani worɓe ɓen : geɓal immorde e kon ko neene e baaba e ɓadiiɓe ngacci ko; wano banndi- raaɓe ɓen maa kaawu e bappa e baaba en mawɗo, si wonii ɓe faatike, ɗuuɗi famɗi e ko ɓe acci kon. Hino woodani kadi rewɓe ɓen : geɓal immorde e kon ko ɓen ɗon acci ; ɓe haanaa ɗawireede ɗum wano majjunooɓe ɗawiraynoo rewɓe e paykoy ka ndonndi. Ngal geɓal ko haqqee maɓɓe ɓannginaaɗo emmbere mun, ngal Alla Toowuɗo On Farli.
